confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'This indicates an earth leakage fault—electricity is escaping from the high-voltage induction components (the coils or power modules) to the metal casing'

rationale: The assistant correctly told the customer to stop using the hob and get an electrician or engineer to check it, and it did not recommend any part. It overstated certainty, calling the fault an earth leakage fault in the hob's coils or power modules, when overload or circuit causes were still possible. It also never asked which switch trips (RCD or MCB) or about boil-overs, and it referred to a 'fused spur' and 'unplug' for a hard-wired hob. The first turn's questions about instant versus delayed tripping were of low value to the customer, and the second turn gave no new questions.
